name: MonarchSignInWithRookButton
title: SignInWithRookButton
summary: The "Sign in with Rook ID" button, in a capsule with fixed light, dark and neutral looks and a loading state. Rook-scoped.
whenToUse: On a sign-in screen of an app that offers Rook ID sign-in. The app runs the sign-in itself, for example in a Custom Tab, from onClick.
whenNotToUse: Outside Rook, or for any other sign-in provider: use MonarchButton. For the main action of a form use MonarchButton with the primary variant.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSignInWithRookButton(onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchSignInWithRookButtonVariant = MonarchSignInWithRookButtonVariant.Light, size: MonarchSignInWithRookButtonSize = MonarchSignInWithRookButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, fullWidth: Boolean = false, mark: Painter? = null, label: String? = null, loadingLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)
enum class MonarchSignInWithRookButtonVariant { Light, Dark, Neutral, Auto }
enum class MonarchSignInWithRookButtonSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: onClick
options.description: Called when the button is activated and not loading.

options.name: variant
options.description: Light, Dark and Neutral look the same on every screen; Auto follows the theme.

options.name: size
options.description: 32, 40 or 48dp high. The touch target is at least 48dp at every size.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the button can be activated.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows a progress indicator in place of the mark, reads "Loading" and ignores taps.

options.name: mark
options.description: The Rook ID mark, drawn before the label at 16, 20 or 24dp without a tint. Decorative.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Sign in with Rook ID".

options.name: loadingLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in "Loading" state read while loading.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press, focus and hover interactions.

states.name: resting
states.description: A capsule on the surface color with the strong border; Neutral is a muted fill without a border.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The muted background; the emphasis background for Neutral, plus the Material 3 ripple.

states.name: loading
states.description: A progress indicator replaces the mark; the colors stay at full contrast.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The subtle background, the disabled text color and the subtle border.

appearance: A capsule. Light and Neutral take their roles from the light theme and Dark from the dark theme, whatever the theme of the screen; when the screen uses a high-contrast theme they use the high-contrast light or dark theme. Auto uses the roles of the screen's theme. Roles: surface or muted fill, default text, strong border.
platformNotes: Rook-scoped: it exists for Rook ID only. The web can render a link (href); on Android it is always a button and the app opens the sign-in, for example in a Custom Tab. Monarch ships no artwork, so the mark is a Painter the app passes; the web's markSrc URL is not offered because Monarch loads no images. iOS also takes a markURL loaded with AsyncImage; Android does not. The web dims a disabled button with opacity; Android uses the disabled color roles. The web's block is fullWidth, as on iOS. The light and dark looks are pinned by drawing the button inside a MonarchTheme with a fixed scheme.
accessibility: A Material 3 button with the Button role, named by its label.
The mark is an Image with a null content description, so TalkBack skips it.
While loading the state description is "Loading", the button is reported as disabled and onClick does not run.
The touch target is at least 48dp high at every size, reserved in the layout.
The label grows with the font size setting and wraps rather than being cut.
edgeCases: Without a mark the button shows the label only.
The mark is drawn as given, without a tint, and is not dimmed when disabled.
A long label wraps inside the capsule and the button grows in height.
